Hi Lena / Tom —

As we prep for the upcoming Renewal QBR (contract renewal + product roadmap review), I wanted to surface a small scheduling proposal that reduces exec contention and surfaces the right delegates up front. Attached is a quick availability matrix (availability-matrix.csv) — filled with the preliminary dates your team mentioned in the last call.

Suggested approach (quick):
- Offer two consolidated windows (both 90m):
  1) Wed, Jul 11 — 10:00–11:30 PT (US-focused)
  2) Thu, Jul 12 — 14:00–15:30 PT (EMEA-friendly overlap)
- If exec availability is tight, run two 45m sessions split by audience: "Executive + Business" and "Technical deep dive (SE-led)".
- Please indicate if you want the session recorded and/or broken into shorter breakouts.

Ask from you: please: 1) confirm preferred window (one or both), 2) identify delegates (names + roles) who can present or answer procurement/security questions, and 3) flag any non-negotiable agenda items (SLA, dedicated capacity pricing, private deployment compliance).

I've cc'ed Marissa (CS lead) and Karthik (Solutions Eng) to align run-of-show and backup hosts.

Attachments: renewal-MAP-v3.pdf (one-pager MAP), availability-matrix.csv

Thanks — happy to shift windows based on your constraints.
